title: The Evolution of Wireless Charging

scenes.fact: The first standard for wireless charging was introduced at just 5 watts.
scenes.text: Did you know 5w was the first wireless charge speed?

scenes.query2: how fast can wireless charging be
scenes.text: Now, wireless chargers reach speeds up to 100 watts, revolutionizing convenience.
Follow for the future, one byte at a time.

description: Wireless charging has evolved from 5 watts to nearly 100 watts. Discover the journey of this convenience revolution!
